figures.caption: Figure 3: Effect of evidential gap filling is statistically insignificant on completeness. The solid and open marks represent two disjoint query sets, where solid marks indicate queries where flagged gaps triggered a second iteration. The prognostic-only variant is omitted due to its lack of gap analysis and strategy conditioning. The diagnostic variants differ in execution: Diag (exp) explicitly classifies and audits queries against strategy templates, whereas Diag (imp) receives no explicit criteria.
